demonstrations.title: Sternum Plate — Single Impact
demonstrations.description: Isolate the current high-hit candidate plate, mount it in the instrumented test frame, and fire one controlled prototype round.
demonstrations.researchQuestion: How should the plate trade impact resistance, mass, and heat transfer?

demonstrations.title: Thermal Dissipation — Prototype B
demonstrations.description: Route a larger share of the weapon's waste heat into the exoskeleton heat-exchange path and compare cooldown behavior.
demonstrations.researchQuestion: Can the chassis accept and spread the thermal load without creating a new hot spot?

demonstrations.title: Plate Construction — Cutaway
demonstrations.description: Inspect the plate's current blockout layers and unknowns without firing a weapon.
demonstrations.researchQuestion: Which layer stack, interfaces, and acceptance criteria should be researched first?
